newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Email happy with market forecasts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Email happy with market forecasts.

text.p: Appliance and building products manufacturer Email Ltd said on Friday it was comfortable with analysts' profit forecasts for the year to March 31, 1998.
"In general, yes," Email Managing Director John Hanna told reporters after the company's annual meeting when asked if he was comfortable with analysts' forecasts.
Analysts are forecasting profit before abnormals for the year of about A$70 million.
"I think it depends on some of these economic forecasts," Hanna said.
"We think we are getting an improvement, but it's how much improvement," he said.
Chairman Peter Cottrell said a challenge in the short-term was to improve the return on shareholders funds back to double digits from its current level of around 7.6 percent.
He said this would be certainly achievable within two years.
Cottrell said there was still hesitancy in the economy despite recent interest rate cuts and an expected upturn in housing had been pushed out by six months.
"In appliances there is a demand, but in all other areas it's true there is not much growth at this stage," Hanna said.
"What we are trying to do is take the company forward without too much help from the economy."
Email was trading down six cents at A$4.64 at 12.50 p.m. (0250 GMT).
